failure.title: Production web readiness did not recover within budget after restart
failure.note: The fourth cold Docker protocol passed QA-DKR-001 through QA-DKR-009, then retained a structured timeout because /health/ready did not return HTTP 200 within 60 seconds after restarting the web service.
failure.diagnosis: The same web container recovered to healthy internally, but Docker remapped its host port from 55063 to 55064 during restart. The verifier continued polling the stale pre-restart port, so it timed out without observing the healthy process.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
